post.title: How apartment landlords make millions beyond rent
post.ig:
Camden collected $173.6 million beyond rent in 2025.
The apartment landlord (58,759 homes) books it as other services, mostly utility rebills and fees: about 11% of its 2025 property revenue, up from $120.8M in 2020.
Our math: $173.6M / 58,759 homes = roughly $246 a month per home.
In Dec. 2025, Greystar agreed to pay $24M to settle FTC and Colorado charges that its ads hid mandatory fees like valet trash and smart home packages. Greystar denied wrongdoing.
Sources: Camden Q4 2025 and earlier earnings releases (SEC filings), FTC press releases (Jan. 16 and Dec. 2, 2025).
News and education, not financial advice.
